messages.subject: Interpretation of estimates
parts:
Hi all,

I am using BSEM to estimate correlations between latent variables, and I am not sure which values in the summary correspond to these correlations. Should I be looking at the regression table or the covariance table? And I think it should be the Std.lv column? 

Thanks in advance!

Best, 
Annemieke

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Interpretation of estimates
parts:
Annemieke

If you have a covariance between factors, the correlation will be in the std.all column
